# existence destruction event

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:existenceDestructionEvent`](gmeow-existenceDestructionEvent.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/existenceDestructionEvent>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/lifecycle`](../../slices/lifecycle.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The destruction event associated with this existence record. Optional: an [`EntityExistence`](../classes/gmeow-EntityExistence.md) for a still-extant entity has no destruction event.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:EntityExistence`](../classes/gmeow-EntityExistence.md) -> [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:existenceDestructionEvent`](gmeow-existenceDestructionEvent.md) from [`gmeow:EntityExistence`](../classes/gmeow-EntityExistence.md) to [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:EntityExistence`](../classes/gmeow-EntityExistence.md), [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use on an [`EntityExistence`](../classes/gmeow-EntityExistence.md) to name its destruction event when the existence claim is reified and the entity has ceased to exist.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it on the flat form (use [`gmeow:hasDestructionEvent`](gmeow-hasDestructionEvent.md) directly on the entity) and omit it entirely for a still-extant entity, whose existence record leaves the interval open.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:existenceDestructionEvent`](gmeow-existenceDestructionEvent.md) from the [`EntityExistence`](../classes/gmeow-EntityExistence.md) to a [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) co-typed with the appropriate [`EventType`](../classes/gmeow-EventType.md); leave it absent while the entity remains extant.

### Examples

- ex:troyExistence [`gmeow:existenceDestructionEvent`](gmeow-existenceDestructionEvent.md) ex:sack.
